source.name: Custom additive string synthesizer
source.upstreamVersion: synthNotes/StringSynth_A0-C8.sf2, regenerated from MATLAB 2026-11-08 (V4 dark calibration)
source.license: Project owner generated; no third-party sample content
source.modifications: 88 one-shot mono 48 kHz PCM16 samples for MIDI 21-108, regenerated by the original MATLAB scripts at 0.120 RMS with the owner-selected V4 dark calibration (slopeP 1.55, lowpass 1500 Hz guitar / 900 Hz bass, Q 0.5, body peaks x0.8), written by synthNotes/tools/build_sf2.py into one bank 0/program 0 preset. The SF2 is the tracked generator input at synthNotes/StringSynth_A0-C8.sf2 and is not packaged; the shipped instrument asset is the EARP1 pack.
source.buildNotes: Owner selected the custom synth as 0.9.23 on 2026-10-24, then requested twice the output level on 2026-10-24; the MATLAB source target and bundled font were regenerated at 0.120 RMS. Bass timbre covers MIDI 21-59; guitar timbre covers MIDI 60-108. On 2026-11-08 the owner chose the V4 dark calibration for a stronger fundamental; the 88 notes, font and pack were regenerated from it. The SoundFont moved out of the packaged assets on 2026-11-08 when the sample player became the only engine.

review.notes: Owner accepted the 0.120 RMS custom string synth and the 0.9.28 uniform +1.06 dB output trim on 2026-10-24. Owner accepted the V4 dark calibration and the sample-player playback on 2026-11-08.
